title: From source material to a reviewed question bank
purpose: Choose the right import path, repair uncertain answers, and create practice without repeating extraction.
youtube_title: DLMS: Import PDFs and Screenshots, Repair Questions, Create Practice
description: Follow the path from structured source material to reusable practice in DLMS. Learn when to use PDF text or local OCR, what to check in Review & Repair, and how a saved Question Bank differs from a playable quiz. The repair example uses an original staged draft; it is not an OCR accuracy benchmark.

scenes.title: Choose a source path
scenes.visual_focus: Build Quiz offers separate routes; do not imply every document goes through OCR.
scenes.narration: Start in Build Quiz and choose the path that fits your material. Structured choice questions can come from text, while terminology pairs can come from CSV. For a PDF or a screenshot, open PDF and Image Import. These are different inputs, so check the manual's format examples before preparing a large file.

scenes.title: Prefer selectable PDF text
scenes.visual_focus: PDF analysis form, content type, source title and rights confirmation.
scenes.narration: If you can select the words in a PDF reader, try normal PDF analysis first. Choose the document, give the source bank a useful title, and select Question bank, Glossary, or Auto-detect. Confirm that you may use the material, then Analyze PDF. Structured questions work better than an arbitrary textbook chapter.

scenes.title: Use local OCR deliberately
scenes.visual_focus: Original screenshot selected; this frame precedes OCR submission.
scenes.narration: For questions that exist only as pixels, use Import Quiz Screenshots. DLMS reads them with local OCR when its OCR runtime is available. Mixed PDFs can offer selected low-text pages for OCR instead. Recognition produces drafts, not trusted answers. A highlighted choice alone is not evidence that the answer is correct.

scenes.title: Repair the missing answer
scenes.visual_focus: Incomplete filter and missing correct-answer field in original staged draft.
scenes.narration: Review and Repair separates complete records from those needing attention. Here, the recovered question has choices but no confirmed answer. Compare it with your source, repair the text and correct-answer set, or exclude it if you cannot verify it. For multiple-answer questions, check every correct choice. Nothing is published just by opening this review.

scenes.title: Save the reviewed source
scenes.chapter: Save a bank and make practice
scenes.visual_focus: Review summary; saving is explained as the next action, not shown as already completed.
scenes.narration: When every included record is valid, choose Save Reviewed Question Bank. Check OCR correctness confirmations against their source previews before saving. This demonstration uses an original staged draft; it does not claim automatic recovery of a missing answer. The saved bank is your reusable source collection, separate from the quizzes you create from it.

scenes.title: Generate a manageable practice set
scenes.visual_focus: Actual bank generator after repairing and saving the two original questions.
scenes.narration: Now choose a quiz title, question count, selection method, and Exam timer. Random, unused, sequential, and range selections let you reuse the bank for different sessions. Choose Create Quiz to make a playable copy. The reviewed source stays intact, so your next practice session does not require importing and checking the same document again.
